messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - Streaming timeouts and retry storms detected for tenant 'astrahealth' on Dedicated pool astro-prod-vpc. Symptoms: websocket disconnects, repeated client reconnects, gateway 502/504, 429 spikes. Alert: gw_streaming_disconnect_rate > 5% for 3m. Paging on-call.

maria (oncall): I'm on it — seeing a spike in websocket disconnects from appgw-router -> our gateway. Root path /v1/stream. First look: appgw logs show 503/504 and a bunch of 429 from our upstream.

leo (eng-runtime): I can tail the dedicated pool. Filter: tenant=astrahealth, pool=astro-prod-vpc, node=gpu-4. Starting `journalctl -u inference-runtime -f` on gpu-4.

samir (sre): Quick read: looks like their app gateway is opening a ton of concurrent streams, then timing out and retrying. That causes our KV cache thrash and backend queuing. Two immediate mitigation options: 1) rate-limit/conn-limit per-tenant at the ingress, 2) switch tenant to polling fallback (disable streaming) while we stabilize.

ash (ops-bot): runbook check: for streaming timeout storms -> recommended: apply per-tenant connection limit, increase http keepalive on proxy, and disable streaming route for tenant if needed.

ash (ops-bot): Suggested command snippets for mitigation (use with infra role):
```
# set per-tenant conn limit
redwood ctl routes update --tenant astrahealth --conn-limit 120
# route to polling fallback
redwood ctl routes update --tenant astrahealth --fallback-mode polling
```

elaine (infra): I can apply the routing change now. Applying conn-limit + polling fallback on the edge. Pushing change to gateway-config (dry-run -> apply).

elaine (infra): `PATCH /config/gateway/tenants/astrahealth` -> set conn_limit=120, streaming_enabled=false. Applying...

ops-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: gateway-config patch accepted (cfg-v2026.3.41). Rolling to astro-prod-vpc.

ash (ops-bot): Note: this is a config-level change, will not require restart of runtime. Expect effect within ~15s after rollout per node.

ashwin (support): Astra-ops just posted: "Users see chat freezing, messages duplicated on reconnect, mobile app retries aggressively. We're escalating to our product team." They've requested ETA. I'm on customer comms.

jules (solutions): I'll tell them 15-20m while we stabilize. Also asking for any appgw logs they can share (timeout codes, upstream stream resets).

leo (eng-runtime): After gating astrahealth to polling fallback and conn-limit, I see a drop in websocket disconnects on gpu-4. Metrics: streaming_disconnect_rate 5% -> 0.8% in 3m. Token generation latency normalized. KV cache evictions decreased by ~70%.

maria (oncall): Good. Confirming we still see spikes of 429 from appgw but fewer client reconnect loops. Can we also increase NGINX keepalive/timeouts on the customer-facing proxy? 30s -> 90s maybe. That should reduce half-open sockets when mobile reconnects.

elaine (infra): Will push a targeted keepalive bump for the astra host in the VPC ingress config. Patch: `proxy_read_timeout 90s; proxy_send_timeout 90s; keepalive_timeout 90s;` applying to astra-vpc-only.

ops-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: ingress keepalive applied to astra-vpc (rollout id cfg-v2026.3.42).

samir (sre): Observing reduced retry loops from client side. We should consider a temporary token-level throttle on the model side too: reduce concurrent inference slots for tenant to avoid GPU queue blowup. Command: `redwood ctl pools scale --pool astro-prod-vpc --tenant astrahealth --max-concurrency 10`.

leo (eng-runtime): Done for now, set max-concurrency=10 for astra tenant. Monitoring queue length.

maria (oncall): Queue depth dropped to normal. No new 504s for last 4 minutes. Customer reports fewer freezes.

ashwin (support): Astra-ops: "Thanks — we see chat working again on mobile and web. Some message duplicates cleared up." They asked what caused it. I'll draft a short postmortem blurb: probable cause = client retry storm against streaming endpoint + gateway timeouts + insufficient per-tenant conn limits causing resource contention in dedicated pool.

jules (solutions): I'm creating a follow-up ticket for product integration work with Astra: add client pacing guidance, handshake backoff, and explicit streaming fallback. Ticket: PROD-7881 (Astra streaming resilience).

samir (sre): For immediate operational notes: we temporarily disabled streaming for astra (fallback to polling), applied per-tenant conn-limit=120, bumped ingress keepalive to 90s, reduced tenant concurrency to 10. Recommend a post-incident runbook item: 1) add tenant-aware circuit breaker for streaming in the gateway, 2) automated short-circuit to fallback when disconnect_rate > 3% for 5m.

maria (oncall): I'm handing off since my shift ends in 14m. Summary for next oncall (samir): P1->mitigated. Key points: dedicated pool isolation, applied routing & keepalive, monitoring stable. Logs & metrics links: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/streams?tenant=astrahealth and logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/q?tenant=astrahealth&pool=astro-prod-vpc.

samir (sre): Got it — taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate the postmortem. Adding myself to customer follow-up.

maria (oncall): Customer notify sent: "We've applied temporary mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a detailed root cause and remediation plan." Flags: follow-up ticket PROD-7881 assigned to eng-runtime and solutions.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded P1 -> P2 (mitigated). Time to mitigation: ~18 minutes. Please create a postmortem and link to PROD-7881.

samir (sre): I'll file the postmortem and include timeline, metrics, and proposed code changes (gateway tenant circuit breaker + client pacing docs).

maria (oncall): Closing live paging. If any regressions in next 2 hours ping @samir. Nice job team. :+1:
